title: Senior PDGS Fullstack Developer
description:
Employment type: FULL_TIME
Applicants must be located in: Poland
Overall:
At Creotech, we build cutting-edge software solutions for the Space & Earth Observation (EO) industry. We develop advanced system that processes, catalogs, and delivers satellite imagery and scientific payload data to commercial partners, research institutions, and international space agencies.
We are looking for a skilled and passionate Software Developer to join our Payload Data Ground Segment Engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing our Payload Data Ground System (PDGS) and our modern User Access Service (UAS) platform. Our team is small and engineers are able to make real decisions.
About the role:
As a Software Developer in our team, you will operate at the intersection of high-performance backend pipelines and geospatial web delivery systems.
You will design automated ingestion & processing workflows for satellite payload streams and construct high-availability APIs (STAC/REST) that allow users to search, filter, and stream earth observation assets seamlessly.
Key responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain innovative software solutions for satellite payload data ordering, reception, processing, archiving and distribution

Contribute to system development process across the full lifecycle

Design and prototype automated workflows for processing of raw payload data into standarized EO products (GeoTIFF, COG)

Design APIs and service communication using REST and Message Queues.

Write clean, efficient, well-documented and testable code.

Manage software engineering fundamentals, including documentation, version control, and team collaboration.

Identify and resolve bugs and issues

Deploy and monitor developed systems

Requirements (fundamental):
Minimum of 5 years of professional software development experience within microservices architecture and frontend development

Expert in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent experience

Proven experience in web apps (Angular, React or similar) development

Strong knowledge of SQL, NoSQL databased (e.g. PostgreSQL, MongoDB)

Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, S3 objects storage (e.g. AWS S3, MinIO)

Experienced with GIT and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI)

Self-driven and capable of working independently in a full remote team environment

Solid software engineering fundamentals: clean code, unit testing, git workflows, CICD automation

Comfortable working in a Linux environment

 Nice to Have:
Knowledge and/or experience in space sector projects related with satellite data processing performed for example for ESA. Knowledge of PDGS terminology and standards e.g. image quality.

Familiarity with EO standards and formats: STAC specification, GeoTIFF, COG, GeoJSON

Experience with Geospatial tooling: PySTAC, GDAL, Rasterio, Shapely, NumPy

Experience with workflow engines (e.g. Apache Airflow, Prefect, Argo Workflows)

Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP

Familiarity with DevOps practices and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible)

Knowledge of web mapping libraries (CesiumJS, OpenLayers, Leaflet, Mappbox GL)

Experience with automated testing frameworks and tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress)

 We offer
Work in a friendly, well-coordinated team of enthusiasts

Stable employment in a modern company with an established market position

Attractive salary and benefits package (e.g., private medical care, sports card)

Opportunities for professional development and participation in innovative projects

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend | Spain | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend

The Opportunity:

Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem.

As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana.

You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise.

AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Be accountable for the performance of two distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability.

Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs.

Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities.

Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands.

Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk.

Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through.

Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.

Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities.

Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need.

Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.

Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.

Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.

What Makes You a Great Fit

Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.

A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.

A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.

Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.

Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.

description:

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

About the role
You’ll build the tools that make Studio a video editor people want to live in. These include transitions, color grading and elements libraries all built on top of our in-house engine. You’ll also build presets, so a user can get the effect they want without tweaking 20 individual controls.
The work mixes greenfield features with polish on the existing editor. An example of the polish is letting editors coming from Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro rebind their keyboard shortcuts in one step. You’ll write proposals, get fast feedback, and own features through launch, including the marketing moment.
You’re a product-minded, frontend-leaning full-stack engineer. Deep backend skills aren’t required.

Requirements

Strong frontend engineer who has built complex, interactive UIs.

Enough full-stack ability to work across the stack, but deep backend expertise isn’t needed.

Evidence of product responsibility: side projects, open source, or product-facing work.

Thrives in a fast-moving, startup-style environment, and takes ownership with minimal hand-holding.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Développeur fullstack confirmé H/F (C#, .Net, Angular)
description:
À propos de N2JSoft

N2JSoft est une Fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.
Fondée en 2015, elle compte aujourd’hui 20 000 clients et 1M utilisateurs dans 98 pays , faisant de N2F l’un des leaders du marché français.
N2F simplifie la gestion des frais professionnels : photo des justificatifs, reconnaissance automatique, validation, export comptable, archivage à valeur probante , etc.

L’objectif : faire gagner du temps aux entreprises tout en sécurisant leurs processus internes.
Après une croissance progressive, l’équipe est passée de 20 personnes en 2021 à 230 aujourd’hui , portée par le succès produit et l’expansion internationale.
Nous partageons un objectif commun : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des notes de frais et des factures fournisseurs.
En 2021, N2JSoft a élargi son expertise avec Keeple , un logiciel RH dédié aux congés, absences et temps de travail (hors périmètre de ce poste).

Quelques chiffres
230 collaborateurs , dont 50 dans l'équipe tech

Notre site est basé à Montagnat (01) avec un format de télétravail hybride ou full remote.

L’équipe tech
Notre équipe est composée de développeurs/euses full stack expérimenté(e)s , réparti(e)s en squads : Notes de frais, Cartes de paiement pro, Invoices, Core…
Chaque squad réunit : développeurs/euses, tech lead, team lead, product manager et testeur/euses QA.

Stack et pratiques
Front : Angular 16/21
Back : .NET 10 – C#
Infra : AWS
BDD : MSSQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB
Architecture : monolithe modulaire
Bonnes pratiques : tests unitaires, revues de code, pair programming, couverture Qodana, Microsoft Release Flow.
Méthodo : Agile Scrum, sprints de 2 semaines (daily, weekly, rétro, planning).

Le profil recherché
Rattaché(e) à un(e) Team Lead dans l'une des squads produit, tu disposes :
D'une formation en informatique Bac+3 minimum

De 3 ans d’expérience en .NET / C# (web ou backend)

De 2 ans d'expérience sur Angular et de bonnes connaissances front-end (HTML/CSS, TypeScript)

D'une bonne maîtrise de SQL

D'une expérience avec les technologies Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et Docker

Et tu fais preuve :
D' esprit d’équipe pour travailler dans un climat de confiance, d'entraide et de responsabilité partagée

De curiosité et d'ouverture pour comprendre le besoin de nos utilisateurs et l'environnement technique

De pragmatisme et rigueur pour produire un code fiable avec un impact maîtrisé.

Les points d’attention :
Il est crucial de bien comprendre le périmètre fonctionnel du produit pour réussir dans ce poste.

Nous recherchons quelqu’un qui souhaite s’investir dans la durée et contribuer à la construction d’un projet pérenne, plutôt qu’à une mission ponctuelle.

Les plus :
Une croissance forte et continue (50% par an depuis 3 ans) dans une entreprise rentable

Une structure claire et spécialisée avec une équipe tech solide et des squads bien identifiées

Une stack moderne régulièrement mise à jour, avec des migrations planifiées et suivies

Pas de micro management et une culture de travail basée sur la confiance et l’écoute

La possibilité de faire du full-remote avec une semaine de présence par trimestre

Processus de recrutement
Préqualification avec nos recruteurs

Test technique à réaliser en autonomie (7 jours de deadline)

Entretien technique / code review avec notre équipe tech (1h)

Entretien avec le CTO (40 min)

A la fin du processus de recrutement, une rencontre plus informelle de 20 minutes peut être organisée afin de rencontrer tes futurs collègues.

Télétravail :
Environ 100 de nos collaborateurs travaillent en full remote , depuis différentes régions. Pour celles et ceux qui résident à proximité de nos locaux, une présence quotidienne est privilégiée (avec un jour de télétravail par semaine ). Les personnes situées à environ une heure de route viennent généralement deux jours par semaine sur site.
Pour les collaborateurs en full remote , nous organisons une semaine de présence par trimestre , prise en charge par l’entreprise, afin de renforcer les liens avec l’équipe et de partager les temps forts de la vie interne.
Ces semaines s’inscrivent dans notre rythme d’ événements trimestriels (ateliers, moments conviviaux, séminaires, etc.), qui participent à la cohésion et à la culture d’équipe.
En résumé, nous adaptons le rythme de télétravail à la situation géographique de chacun , dans un esprit de flexibilité, de confiance et de collaboration .

Rémunération et avantages
40–53k€ brut annuel en fonction de l’expérience/niveau technique

CDI cadre – 37h/semaine

Prime de vacances

Chèques cadeaux, culture, rentrée scolaire

Cours de musique sur site

Événements d’équipe toute l’année

N2JSOFT s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité hommes-femmes et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés.

Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.

You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.

Why this role exists

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

What you’ll do

Product contribution

  • Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.
  • Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.
  • Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

Strategic technical stewardship

  • Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.
  • Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.
  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.
  • Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.
  • Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle

  • Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.
  • Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.
  • Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.
